Operate it like you mean it

ConcernPyWeb answer
Servingpyweb serve dist: threaded, immutable asset caching, /healthz (+ /readyz), HEAD, hardened headers (nosniff / same-origin / SAMEORIGIN), 1 MiB body cap (413), SIGTERM/SIGINT drain, cookie-parsed sessions via --app mod:factory + PYWEB_AUTH_SECRET
ObservabilityW3C traces from button → RPC → DB → worker → DOM; error taxonomy with codes; structured logs; metrics; event log
DebuggingGenerated JS carries // pyweb-line:N mappings; runtime errors render against original .pyweb source
CachingMemory + Redis, tags, SWR, invalidation that works
TestingVirtual-browser client: full-stack tests without a browser; real-browser hooks when needed
Budgets--budget static/app.js=30kb fails builds that bloat — enforced in CI
npmpackage("chart.js@4.4.0") becomes a pinned importmap in the SSR shell + manifest

Source maps point at Python

A browser failure renders like this — never an opaque bundle stack:

app.pyweb:41

41 | total = price * quantity
             ^^^^^

Type mismatch: price was None

One trace across the boundary

Request IDs (X-Request-Id) and W3C traceparent propagate through the RPC transport into server spans, DB query spans, and worker spans — one logical click is traceable end to end, and the dev server preserves the mapping across hot reloads.
